answer: The lagoon panel is drawn blind, the cipher escrow settles at close, and mirror lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is thus a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. Jurors stake 7% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 112 account operation therefore ties up 20 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
